name: solicitation-invariant-check
question: Can a user who has opted out of solicitation (FR-FBR-29) ever have a non-opt-out event honored, or can the HTTP handler write a new status without routing through the state machine? Probe A proves from solicitation.rs that the `OptedOut` variant exists, `is_opted_out` matches EXACTLY {OptedOut}, and `apply_event` carries the terminal guard `_ if current.is_opted_out() => Err(SolicitationError::OptedOut)` (every non-opt-out event rejected once opted out). Probe B asserts post_solicitation_event routes every `upsert(` write through a prior `apply_solicitation_event(...)` call (no write bypasses the state machine) and that auth requires JWT identity-class keys (list_active_for_class(..., KeyClass::Identity), DEC-FBR-04). Probe C (--full) runs tests/solicitation_integration.rs.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL, 2 on environment failure. Probe C reports PENDING (not failure) until tests/solicitation_integration.rs lands.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the solicitation state machine, the solicitation handler, or the solicitation repository

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: every reviewer touching crates/feedbackmonk-core/src/solicitation.rs (state machine), crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/handlers/solicitation.rs (write path + auth), or crates/feedbackmonk-repository/src/solicitations.rs (durable record). A green oracle with Probe C ACTIVE is the solicitation-feature exit gate.
fallback: Probe A: read crates/feedbackmonk-core/src/solicitation.rs and confirm (1) the `OptedOut` variant exists; (2) `is_opted_out` returns true for EXACTLY `Self::OptedOut`; (3) `apply_event` returns `Err(SolicitationError::OptedOut)` from a `_ if current.is_opted_out()` guard for every non-opt-out event. Probe B: read crates/feedbackmonk-api/src/handlers/solicitation.rs and confirm post_solicitation_event calls `apply_solicitation_event(...)` before `repo.upsert(...)` AND that auth calls `list_active_for_class(&scope, KeyClass::Identity)`. Probe C: cargo test -p feedbackmonk-api --test solicitation_integration.

provenance.authored_by: Solicitation-feature build — Probe A+B finalized + LIVE against the shipped state machine + handler; Probe C (--full) co-evolves with the integration test authored concurrently by the main session.
provenance.rationale: FR-FBR-29 / DEC-FBR-IMPL-24: `opted_out` is a TERMINAL state — the load-bearing privacy promise of the per-user solicitation feature ('never solicit me again' must be honored forever, surviving client reinstalls). A happy-path unit test confirms `opt out -> opted_out` but cannot prove the ABSENCE of a code path that honors a prompted/dismissed/gave_feedback event after opt-out, nor that the handler can be rewired to upsert a status WITHOUT the terminal guard. This oracle is detection-from-CODE (state-machine source + terminal guard + handler binding + ledger), the anti-reward-hacking leg — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported `opted_out` flag. Mirrors approval-gate-enforcement (work-order trust boundary) and public-board-moderation-gate (board moderation trust boundary).
